english.note: Use this as the all-purpose casual apology, especially for a minor imposition or embarrassment.
Use this when being ashamed shades into feeling embarrassed, awkward, or sorry toward someone else.
Use this polite phrase when expressing regret or reluctance before saying something unpleasant.

examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 ngo5 ci4 dou3 zo2

examples.english: I’m ashamed to have kept you waiting so long.
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 zo2 zyu6 nei5 gam3 noi6

examples.english: Sorry, I'm afraid I can't go to the hospital with you because I'm afraid of seeing blood.
examples.traditional: 唔好意思，我唔可以陪你去醫院，因為我好怕見到血。
